svg.title: Setting up the search
svg.desc: Install the app. In the administration settings of Nextcloud, enter the URL and the archive account, and select Paperless runs in my local network when Nextcloud reaches Paperless at such an address. Then connect a Paperless account that may only read: let the settings create it with the token of a superuser of Paperless, which is not stored, with Create the search account and save; or create the account and its API token in Paperless-ngx, enter the token and select Test connection and save. When Paperless answers, the settings are saved; otherwise nothing is saved and the message says what to correct. The archive account shares its archive read-only with the users who may find its documents, and they find them under Paperless documents in Nextcloud's search, with Search connected services switched on.
